changelog:
SOLO v2.0.0 introduces a comprehensive "三权制衡" (Separation of Powers) architecture for agent operations.

- Full architecture rewrite: kernel (legislative), SOLO audit (judicial), skills (executive).
- Strict boundary rules: immutable core (laws), read-only judicial layer (audits only, no SOP changes), execution under double constraint (core + audit).
- Introduces audit mechanism with proposal workflow, memory/audit/ repository, and centralized audit scheduling.
- All skills and tools re-aligned under new core protocols and audit-driven workflows.
- Enables self-evolving audit standards and persistent audit archives (hash chains, proposal records).
- Foundation for meta-agent operations with zero scripting, pure OpenClaw implementation.
summary: SOLO — Solo Operating Legion ⚡ 三权制衡架构。内核(立法) + SOLO审计(司法) + 技能(执行)。meta-agent，零脚本，纯OpenClaw原生。
